fact_sheet_status.notes: Excel Col H blank, but matching public folder found in Drive master folder

min_standing_note.value: Minimum 3.0 GPA equivalency with solid undergraduate academic preparation; official nomination from partner institution required.

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Excel agreement_scope_raw is 'University-wide' (exchange links to Penn's 4 UG schools: College of Arts & Sciences, Wharton, Engineering, Nursing; Law/Med/Dental/Vet & grad courses excluded).

excluded_majors.notes: Incoming UG exchange students are prohibited from taking graduate-level courses or courses in Penn's Law, Medical, Dental, or Veterinary Schools.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Non-native English speakers must submit scores <=2 years old: TOEFL iBT >= 100 (DI code 3221), IELTS Academic >= 7.0, or Duolingo English Test >= 130. RHET 1020 waiver not stated.
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.notes: Updated from 2020-21 docx IELTS 7.5 to 2026-27 Penn Abroad IELTS 7.0 + DET 130.

host_language_requirement.value: English proficiency required for non-native English speakers (TOEFL 100 / IELTS 7.0 / DET 130).

fall_term_dates.value: 2026-08-25 to 2026-12-17 (classes Aug 25–Dec 7; Reading Days Dec 8–9; Final Exams Dec 10–17, 2026)

spring_term_dates.value: 2027-01-20 to 2027-05-17 (classes Jan 20–May 4; Reading Days May 5–6; Final Exams May 7–17, 2027)

tuition_model.notes: Institutional tuition and academic fees are waived for official reciprocal incoming exchange students.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived by dividing 1 semester (half of AY 2026-2027 Room $13,644 + Board $6,960 = $20,604/yr -> $10,302/semester) by 5 months = $2,060.40/mo (excludes Books & Supplies $1,412/yr, PSIP health insurance, Clinical Fee, Orientation Fee, and personal/local transit expenses; 2020-21 docx listed $13,972/sem ISSS visa asset proof).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 1-semester USD Room & Board baseline: half of AY 2026-2027 Room ($13,644) + Board ($6,960) = $10,302.00 USD (excludes Books $1,412/yr, PSIP insurance, Clinical Fee, Orientation Fee, and misc/transit; already in USD, recorded 2026-11-15).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory Penn Student Insurance Plan (PSIP) unless approved comparable waiver (https://shs.wellness.upenn.edu/psipinsurance/), mandatory Immunization Record, Student Health Service Clinical Fee, and Incoming Exchange Orientation & Activities Fee (~$350 Fall/AY, ~$155 Spring in 2020-21 docx).
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: Clinical fee and orientation fee amounts from 2020-21 University of Pennsylvania.docx.

housing_availability.notes: All exchange students are required to live on campus in Penn housing and purchase an on-campus dining plan (single bedrooms rarely available due to demand; https://www.upenn.edu/services/residential).

housing_notes.value: Mandatory on-campus Penn housing & dining plan (AY 2026-27 Penn Abroad estimates: Room $13,644/yr, Board $6,960/yr).

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: J-1 or F-1 student visa required via Penn ISSS (passport valid >=6 months past program end); must submit financial documentation for DS-2019/I-20 (historical 2020-21 docx threshold $13,972/sem or $27,944/2 sems; see global.upenn.edu/isss).

credit_system_and_load.value: Penn Credit Units (c.u.): full-time exchange load requires minimum 4 credit units (typically 4 courses) per semester.

course_restrictions_note.value: Undergraduate courses up to 499-level only. At least 2 of 4 courses (or 3 of 5) must be inside the admitting undergraduate school (CAS/Wharton/Engineering/Nursing); remaining may be in other UG schools. Nominated major must match admitting school. Graduate, Law, Medical, Dental, and Veterinary School courses are prohibited.

value: Passport biographical page scan (valid >=6 months past end of program)
Official TOEFL (100), IELTS (7.0), or Duolingo (130) English test score (if applicable)
required_application_docs.notes: Transcript, essays, and >=6-month passport validity rules cross-referenced with data/raw/factsheets/UoPennsylvania/University of Pennsylvania.docx.

international_support_services.value: Penn Abroad Global Programs Manager advising, admitting-school academic advisor, ISSS J-1/F-1 immigration support (iPenn), Penn Libraries, Weingarten/Writing Center, CAPS, and disability services.

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall Semester / Academic Year: March 20. Spring Semester: September 20 (partner nomination required first; decisions issued ~1 month post-deadline).
